# AI Store

> AI Store is the e-commerce UGC desk of influUGC, a creative marketing and media production agency (est. 2020) based in Agouza, Giza, Egypt. It produces creator-made UGC for online stores and e-commerce brands in Egypt, Saudi Arabia and the wider Gulf — and publishes free, practical guides for store owners on briefing creators, making product videos that convert, and understanding usage rights and whitelisting.

## Guides for store owners (free content)
- Selling into the UAE from your online store (https://aistore.design/#guide-uae): the UAE is a two-language checkout — commission Arabic and English product content as two originals, not translations; film with creators who live the market where possible; settle usage rights for both language versions and both uses (organic and paid) together. Arabic: https://aistore.design/ar.html#guide-uae
- Product videos that convert: UGC for UAE e-commerce brands (https://aistore.design/#guide-uae-ecommerce): the product-page video that closes the sale — what goes in the first three seconds, where UGC beats studio on the product page, how to collect customer video reviews with written permission, and the usage limits that decide how long and where a customer video may run. Arabic: https://aistore.design/ar.html#guide-uae-ecommerce
- Real product videos on the homepages (https://aistore.design/#works): two UGC product videos from influUGC's work for food brands — Healthy & Tasty and Prime Roots — playable with posters. Arabic: https://aistore.design/ar.html#works

- How to brief a UGC creator for a product video: the one-page brief structure — product and audience, one problem per video, three must-show moments, what must never be said, format basics — plus what to send with it and the deliverables to agree in writing before filming.
- What makes a product video convert on TikTok & Reels: open on the product in use, one idea per video, proof over polish, say the offer out loud and in captions, treat the first frame as a thumbnail, rotate angles and keep the winners.
- Usage rights & whitelisting, explained for store owners: receiving the file is not owning every use; usage scope (product pages / organic / paid ads, platforms, duration) belongs in writing before production; whitelisting runs ads through the creator's own handle (TikTok Spark Ads authorisation, Meta partnership permissions), arranged per creator; include raw footage in the original brief if your team re-cuts.

## Services (UGC for e-commerce)

- UGC Video Ads for Product Pages: creator videos made to sit on the product page and carry the ad account — one benefit per video, the product in real use.
- Unboxing & Review-Style Content: first-impression unboxings and honest-review formats, produced with creators the store's customers already watch.
- UGC Ads & Whitelisting (Meta / TikTok): UGC set up to run as ads, including whitelisting through creators' handles via Spark Ads and Meta partnership permissions, documented per creator.
- Product-Launch Creator Seeding: launch waves of designed gifting experiences to a selected creator circle, timed to the launch.
- Monthly UGC Content Packs: a recurring monthly batch of creator videos with rotating angles, planned around the catalogue and seasons. Structure defined in writing; no prices published.
